name: Apple M5 Max (MacBook Pro 14-inch, 2026)
memory_bandwidth_basis: Apple tech specs: '460GB/s memory bandwidth' for the M5 Max with 18-core CPU / 32-core GPU; '614GB/s memory bandwidth' for the M5 Max with 18-core CPU / 40-core GPU. The 614GB/s is the highest configuration. Unified-memory bandwidth, package-level, shared with the CPU.
notes: M5 Max: 32-core or 40-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine, up to 128GB unified memory. The 614GB/s bandwidth (40-core GPU configuration) is the highest for any Apple Silicon laptop chip. For local LLM inference, 128GB unified memory can hold a 70B model at 4-bit (~35GB weights) with massive room for KV cache, or even a 70B model at 8-bit (~70GB weights). The 614GB/s bandwidth yields roughly 15-25 tokens/sec for a 70B model at 4-bit. The M5 Max is the highest-performance Apple Silicon laptop chip for local inference.
